steps.en: A daily job produces the HST summary report
steps.id: Job harian membuat laporan ringkasan HST
steps.why_en: The job runs daily but creates a report only when new address results exist.
steps.why_id: Job jalan harian tetapi hanya membuat laporan bila ada hasil alamat baru.

steps.en: Records to be checked are sent for address checking
steps.id: Record yang dicek dikirim untuk pengecekan alamat
steps.why_en: IDs are sent monthly, not daily, and only NRIC holders are covered; other ID types depend on a switched-off job.
steps.why_id: ID dikirim bulanan, bukan harian, dan hanya pemegang NRIC; jenis ID lain bergantung job yang dimatikan.

steps.en: The report shows how many records were checked
steps.id: Laporan menampilkan jumlah record yang dicek
steps.why_en: The count is for the current month, not for the day.
steps.why_id: Jumlahnya per bulan berjalan, bukan per hari.

steps.en: The report lists records received with new addresses
steps.id: Laporan memuat daftar record hasil yang diterima beserta alamat baru
steps.why_en: The report reads data fields that no code fills in, so it may stay empty.
steps.why_id: Laporan membaca data yang tidak diisi code mana pun, jadi bisa kosong.

steps.en: The report flags records with a detected address change
steps.id: Laporan menandai record dengan perubahan alamat yang terdeteksi
steps.why_en: Detection logic exists but depends on the same unproven result data.
steps.why_id: Logika deteksi ada, tetapi bergantung pada data hasil yang sama yang belum terbukti.

steps.en: The report is routed to the officer's dashboard
steps.why_en: No dashboard or work item exists for this report.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada dashboard atau work item untuk laporan ini.

steps.en: The officer can download the summary report
steps.why_en: Files are stored and emailed, but email is off in production and no portal page offers a download.
steps.why_id: File disimpan dan dikirim lewat email, tetapi email mati di production dan tidak ada halaman portal untuk mengunduh.
